features.description: Stage human-gate evaluation across the dispatch lifecycle. The supervisor today evaluates declared `human_gates` as a single upfront set — every gate must be cleared before iteration 0 of the implementer phase fires, including `pre_merge` which conceptually belongs after the auditor signs off. F001 changes this so each declared human gate fires at its canonical lifecycle point: `pre_impl` before implementer iteration 0, `pre_merge` only when a candidate successful signoff is ready and before `signoff_writer` writes `passes:true`. `gate-state.json` schema is **additive** — the existing `cleared_gates` field is preserved verbatim, two new optional fields layer on top (`gate_events`, `pending_stage`); existing readers continue to work unchanged. Plan B touches **human gates only** — circuit-breaker (`breaker:*`) timing is explicitly unchanged per D001 (zero diffs in `circuit_breakers.py` asserted by grep). Resume-discipline CLI invariants are explicitly preserved per D002 — bare `dontpanic resume <plan>` MUST still exit 2; per-gate clearance flows through `dontpanic approve <plan> <gate>` (clears one staged gate), `dontpanic resume <plan> --gate <gate>` (clears the named gate if it is the canonical pending one), or `dontpanic resume <plan> --all` (bulk-clears pending gates for the current stage). `pre_merge` fires only on the candidate-success path per D005 — it does NOT fire when the run terminates on `needs_changes`, `stopped_no_progress`, `stopped_diminishing_returns`, timeout, or breaker stop. Backwards compat per D004 + D009: a `gate-state.json` containing only the legacy `cleared_gates` field continues to load without error and is treated by the new staged code as pre-cleared at every lifecycle stage (so plans started under the old upfront regime continue to work). Other lifecycle hooks (`pre_audit` per-iteration, `post_merge`) are deliberately reserved-but-not-implemented in F001 — D003. **Do NOT touch historical `docs/plans/` directories outside this plan's own new directory** (per D008 — durable records). **Do NOT touch `claude/shared/`** (agent-conventions subtree — upstream). **Do NOT touch shim files under `scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/`** (Plan A established the shim as non-removing re-export plumbing — D006 of plan 2026-05-04-001).
steps: Pre-flight: clear stale `__pycache__` under `scripts/`; run baseline test sweep (excluding `test_ec5_classifier.py`) and record passing count for post-implementation regression check.

Locate the gate evaluation site(s) in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/supervisor.py` (and `gate_pause.py` if applicable). Identify where `human_gates` is currently evaluated upfront. Record line numbers in the audit envelope.

Add a lifecycle-stage parameter to the gate evaluator: `evaluate_human_gates(plan, gate_state, stage)` where `stage` ∈ {`pre_impl`, `pre_merge`}. The evaluator returns the list of pending gates for that stage; if non-empty, the dispatch pauses with a structured `GatePauseInfo`. If empty, dispatch proceeds.

Update `dispatch_volley()` (or whichever function currently triggers upfront evaluation): replace the single upfront call with two staged calls — one BEFORE spawning the implementer for iteration 0 (passes `stage='pre_impl'`), one AFTER auditor terminal `signoff` AND BEFORE `signoff_writer.write_signoff(passes=True)` (passes `stage='pre_merge'`). The pre_merge call MUST NOT fire on the five non-success terminal states enumerated in D005.

Update `gate-state.json` writer/reader: load tolerates absence of `gate_events` / `pending_stage` (legacy shape readable unchanged). Write populates the new fields when the staged code path is active. Provide a small loader helper `load_gate_state_compat()` that returns a normalized object regardless of input shape.

Verify resume CLI surface unchanged: bare `dontpanic resume <plan>` still exits 2 (existing behavior — do not alter). `dontpanic approve <plan> <gate>` clears one staged gate and writes the corresponding `gate_events` entry. `dontpanic resume <plan> --gate <gate>` clears the named gate when it is the canonical pending one; exits 2 otherwise. `dontpanic resume <plan> --all` bulk-clears the current stage's pending gates.

Add tests at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_lifecycle_staged_gates.py` covering: (a) pre_impl ordering — gate is checked AFTER plan load + capability checks but BEFORE implementer subprocess spawn (use a fake executor seam to assert ordering); (b) clearing pre_impl allows the implementer to fire; (c) pre_merge does NOT block before implementer / auditor execution; (d) pre_merge fires when auditor returns `signoff` AND no blocking findings, before `signoff_writer.write_signoff(passes=True)` — intercepted by a mock; (e) pre_merge does NOT fire when terminal status is `needs_changes`, `stopped_no_progress`, `stopped_diminishing_returns`, timeout, or breaker stop (parametric over the five states); (f) old upfront-cleared `gate-state.json` (legacy shape: `cleared_gates` only) loads cleanly and is treated as pre-cleared at both stages; (g) idempotency: clearing a stage twice is a no-op (no double-fire); (h) bare `dontpanic resume <plan>` exits 2; (i) `--gate` clearance flow works; (j) `--all` clearance flow works; (k) breaker non-interaction — running a plan with a `breaker:*` gate active uses the existing breaker code path, not the new lifecycle code; (l) `circuit_breakers.py` has zero diffs from this commit (grep assertion).

Verify: clear `__pycache__`; run full orchestrate suite from canonical path with `--ignore=scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_ec5_classifier.py`; targeted lifecycle-staged-gates test file runs green; ruff check + ruff format --check across touched files; `python scripts/sanitization_check.py` clean; grep assertion: zero `circuit_breakers.py` diffs from this commit (`git diff --stat scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/circuit_breakers.py | wc -l` returns 0); grep assertion: `git diff --name-only HEAD` shows zero entries under `docs/plans/` outside `2026-05-04-002-fix-supervisor-lifecycle-staged-gates/`.
features.acceptance: (1) **`pre_impl` runtime ordering**: parametric test with a fake executor seam asserts that the `pre_impl` gate is evaluated AFTER plan load + capability checks complete, but BEFORE the implementer subprocess spawns. Tested by injecting a checkpoint that records the call order and asserting the expected sequence. (2) **Clearing pre_impl allows implementation**: with `pre_impl` declared and uncleared, dispatch pauses with a `GatePauseInfo` referencing `pre_impl`; after `dontpanic approve <plan> pre_impl`, dispatch resumes and the implementer fires. (3) **`pre_merge` non-blocking before impl/audit**: with `pre_merge` declared but `pre_impl` cleared, the implementer runs and the auditor runs without `pre_merge` being evaluated. (4) **`pre_merge` blocks ONLY on candidate-success**: when the auditor returns `signoff` AND no blocking findings, `pre_merge` is evaluated immediately before `signoff_writer.write_signoff(passes=True)` — verified by intercepting the signoff write call with a mock and asserting the gate evaluation happened first. (5) **`pre_merge` does NOT fire on five non-success terminal states**: parametric test over `needs_changes`, `stopped_no_progress`, `stopped_diminishing_returns`, timeout, breaker stop. None of these evaluate `pre_merge`; the run terminates and `signoff_writer` writes the appropriate non-success state without ever consulting `pre_merge`. (6) **Additive `gate-state.json` schema — legacy shape**: a fixture file containing only `{"cleared_gates": {"pre_impl": true, "pre_merge": true}}` (legacy shape from upfront regime) loads via `load_gate_state_compat()` without error; the staged dispatch logic treats both stages as pre-cleared and proceeds without prompting. (7) **Additive `gate-state.json` schema — new shape**: a fresh dispatch under the staged regime writes `cleared_gates` (legacy) AND `gate_events` (per-clearance audit log with `gate`, `stage`, `cleared_at`, `cleared_by`) AND `pending_stage` (current stage waiting). Round-trip: write → load → compare structurally equivalent. (8) **Idempotent stage evaluation**: once a stage's gates are all cleared, the supervisor does NOT re-evaluate that stage on subsequent loop iterations OR on resume. Asserted by counting evaluation invocations in a multi-iteration test. (9) **Resume-discipline preserved — bare resume**: `dontpanic resume <plan>` (no flags) exits 2 with a clear usage message. Plan B does NOT walk lifecycle automatically on bare resume. (10) **Resume-discipline preserved — `--gate` flag**: `dontpanic resume <plan> --gate pre_impl` clears `pre_impl` if it is the canonical pending stage's gate; exits 2 with a clear message otherwise (e.g., if the stage is already cleared or the gate is not declared). (11) **Resume-discipline preserved — `--all` flag**: `dontpanic resume <plan> --all` bulk-clears all pending gates for the current stage. (12) **Approve flow**: `dontpanic approve <plan> <gate>` clears exactly one staged gate (the one named) and writes the corresponding `gate_events` entry; refuses if the gate is not currently pending. (13) **Breaker timing unchanged**: `git diff --stat scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/circuit_breakers.py` for this commit reports zero hunks. The existing breaker gate-pause integration code path is untouched. A test exercising a `breaker:*` gate confirms it still pauses at the breaker module's evaluation point, not at a lifecycle stage transition. (14) **Backwards compat for in-flight plans**: a plan started under the old upfront regime (whose `gate-state.json` has the legacy shape with all gates cleared) resumes cleanly under the new staged code — both stages are treated as pre-cleared, no re-prompting. (15) **No `sys.modules` mutation in tests**: per the Plan A learning (test isolation), no Plan B test deletes entries from `sys.modules` to force re-imports. Use `record=True` warning capture and scoped monkeypatching instead. Asserted by grep: `grep -rn 'del.*sys\.modules' scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_lifecycle_staged_gates.py` returns zero hits. (16) **Full orchestrate test suite passes** from canonical path with `--ignore=scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_ec5_classifier.py` (per plan 003 D011 caveat); test count delta vs baseline is exactly +N where N is the count of new tests added in step 7. Zero regressions in any pre-existing test. (17) Ruff check + format clean across touched files. (18) `python scripts/sanitization_check.py` reports 0 findings. (19) **`git diff --name-only HEAD` for this commit shows zero entries under `docs/plans/` outside `2026-05-04-002-fix-supervisor-lifecycle-staged-gates/`** — historical plan dirs / evidence / decisions.jsonl / audit envelopes are byte-identical (durability invariant inherited from Plan A's D003).
